name: Seila
about: Seila is Gladias's wife, a Veridian blogger who writes on economics and culture, and one of the book's three leads. The book describes nothing of her appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: I'm looking forward to your blog
maybe figure out some blog post to write on the United Cities
facts.fact: Travels to Freetown to write about the United Cities.
Seen by Zei and Bai as a woman tourist in Freetown, in ordinary clothes.

facts.quote: Seila put on one of Gladias's privacy robes.
facts.fact: Not an Order member; borrows Gladias's privacy robe for secret errands.

facts.quote: Hopefully the privacy robes will suffice, Gladias thought.
facts.fact: Wears a privacy robe for a security-sensitive walk later in the book.

facts.quote: she had become almost as accustomed to having all of her conversations through neck bands as Gladias had been
facts.fact: Uses a neck band later in the book.

facts.quote: as she was pouring herself a tea

descriptor: a woman in her late thirties, tall and slender, deep brown skin, black hair in shoulder-length braids gathered loosely back, alert dark eyes behind small round gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a long rust-orange woven coat-dress with a sculpted high funnel collar, an asymmetric closure of three bronze clasps running from shoulder to hip and a split hem, over an oatmeal seamless bodysuit, olive gathered trousers, soft tan seamless ankle boots and a thin band around her throat
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain flat off-white background with no scenery: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting. The person is a woman in her late thirties, tall and slender, deep brown skin, black hair in shoulder-length braids gathered loosely back, alert dark eyes behind small round gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a long rust-orange woven coat-dress with a sculpted high funnel collar, an asymmetric closure of three bronze clasps running from shoulder to hip and a split hem, over an oatmeal seamless bodysuit, olive gathered trousers, soft tan seamless ankle boots and a thin band around her throat.
costume_notes: A crossover wrap coat closing at the hip replaces the cardigan, keeping her rust, oatmeal and olive palette, her glasses, and the neck band she uses later in the book. Pushed further after the first render still read as present-day.
